content:
Time is running out for Nuevo Laredo residents who still need to register for federal Bienestar pensions. El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo reports registrations are closing at the Sala Sergio Peña, in the final call for this registration round.

The pensions at stake are the Pensión para el Bienestar de las Personas Adultas Mayores, for people 65 and older, and the Pensión Mujeres Bienestar, for women ages 60 to 64. The national registration window runs Oct. 19–25, with Saturday, Oct. 24 and Sunday, Oct. 25 set aside for all surnames, A through Z, and modules open from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.

Anyone who has not yet registered should go to their assigned module promptly — in Nuevo Laredo, El Mañana points residents to the Sala Sergio Peña — and bring the required identification and documents. Residents can confirm their module at ubicatumodulo.bienestar.gob.mx.

Sources: El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, “Última llamada para registro en programas del Bienestar en Nuevo Laredo; cierran registros en la Sala Sergio Peña,” Oct. 24, 2026.

title: Nuevo Laredo: last call for Bienestar pension registration at Sala Sergio Peña
